verdict.rationale: A state business-filing agency could plausibly offer a documented machine channel with a public sandbox, so this axis applies. The pack contains only robots.txt probes for scc.virginia.gov, cis.scc.virginia.gov and tax.virginia.gov, which say nothing about any API or test environment. With no evidence of a sandbox for exercising a machine rail end to end, the verdict is none. Confidence is medium because the disallow-all robots files meant no documentation was examined.
